# Computing Final Project: Urban Heat Island Intensification in Major US Cities
### Kit Illick cei2119

### April 7, 2026
### Final Project Proposal

In this final project, I plan on comparing how the UHI in New York, Chicago, LA, and Houston have changed over time. I hypothesize that the UHI has gotten larger as these cities continue to develop and expand. I will conduct this analysis by comparing the temperature data from within the city with temperature from close rural temperatures through time to see if the gap between city center and neighboring rural is widening.

#### Dataset
* [NOAA Data](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/land-based-station/global-historical-climatology-network-daily)
* This is NOAA's Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCNd)
